Hebrew – your key to truly feeling at home in Israel 💙🇮🇱

We are proud to announce that starting today, international couples in Israel can enjoy reduced tuition across ALL Ulpan Gordon Hebrew courses.

And there’s more – Three new AIC classes are opening soon. This is your chance to learn Hebrew alongside fellow international couples, connect, and build lasting friendships in Israel!

👇 Who’s eligible?
International couples living in Israel with a valid visa, including:
✅ B1 partner visa holders
✅ A5 partner visa holders
✅ Those who completed the process – now Israeli citizens or permanent residents
✅ Other visa holders with a pending partner visa application

Apply now on: aic.org.il/UlpanGordon
